property_summary: For any caller and any uint _val, calling SetMinSum(_val) on the correct contract always leaves intitalized unchanged from false only if not previously initialized (i.e., SetMinSum does not flip intitalized to true); the mutant wrongly sets intitalized to true after SetMinSum for some inputs, causing subsequent SetMinSum calls to revert while the reference would allow them.
change_summary: Add assignment to set intitalized true when setting MinSum, so subsequent calls will be blocked by original guard behavior.
